description.en: No cards and no panels: the words fill the frame and move on the beat of the voice.
description.vi: Không thẻ, không panel: chữ chiếm trọn khung và nhảy theo nhịp lời.

script.guidance: Write to be read a few words at a time, not a paragraph at a time. Each scene is one short phrase — four to nine words — that could be shouted. No body text, no lists: the phrase is the whole scene.

draw.guidance: The phrase fills the frame edge to edge, set very large — half the frame's width for a short word — and broken across two or three lines by meaning, not by fitting. No card, no panel, no rule, no background shape: the ground is flat colour and the words are the picture. Wrap each word in its own <span class="word"> so it can be timed on its own.
motion: Every word arrives on its own, in reading order: tween each <span class="word"> separately, never the line as a block.

Call nodecine.when() once per word, not once per scene: for a phrase of six words there are six calls, each with that word's own text, and each positions that word's own tween. A scene with one call to when() has not been done.
A word arrives hard and settles: from scale 1.25 and opacity 0 to scale 1 and opacity 1 over about 0.22s with a back or power4 ease — no slow fades, the cut of the motion is the point.
One word of the phrase carries the meaning; give that one the accent colour and one extra move of its own (a small overshoot in scale, or a colour that arrives late).
Nothing drifts in the background. Between words the frame is completely still: the stillness is what makes the next word land.
